# agent-meta

> Meta-repository for standardizing and reusing AI coding-agent role definitions (personas) across projects — role templates, a generation pipeline, and pre-rendered standalone personas usable with no installation at all.

agent-meta is normally embedded as a git submodule and driven by `sync.py`, which generates provider-specific agent files (Claude Code, Gemini/Antigravity, Opencode, Continue, GitHub Copilot, Mammouth Code) from a shared set of role templates under `agents/1-generic/`. It also ships pre-rendered, dependency-free "standalone" personas for use outside that pipeline — no clone, no Python, no config.

## For AI assistants just linked to this repo

If a user pasted you this repo's URL and asked for help with something specific — not to integrate the framework into a codebase — you don't need to clone or run anything:

- [Standalone agent index](standalone/README.md): available roles, one-line description each, links to the persona file for each role
- Fetch the matching file under `standalone/agents/<role>.md` and adopt its whole content as your system prompt / persona for the rest of the conversation
